BrochureContent.Content:
O'Donnellan & Joyce Auctioneers are privileged to offer for sale this spectacular detached residence beautifully positioned with uninterrupted views of Galway Bay & Clare Hills. 
 
Situated on the left hand side of the Coast Road, just at the edge of Barna Village, Duirling Bán is an exceptional picturesque setting offering substantial living accommodation & breath-taking scenery. 
 
Originally constructed in 1972, the home was thoughtfully designed to take advantage of the scenic surroundings with all reception spaces positioned on the upper floor. 
 
The property has been well maintained & has been upgraded with solar panels in recent years. 
 
Consisting of approximately 225 sq.m over two storeys, the residence offers excellent bedroom & living accommodation throughout. 
 
Upon entry, the ground floor is arranged between four sizeable bedrooms, all with fitted storage & the main bedroom availing of its own en-suite, and a main family bathroom. 
 
An attached self-contained unit is positioned at the end of the home consisting of a living space with own entrance, bathroom & a further bedroom. This area can easily be reincorporated into the main house. 
 
Upstairs is beautifully arranged between two large receptions spaces on either side that take advantage of the beautiful surroundings, along with a fitted kitchen & guest bathroom, cloak room & hot-press. 
 
A key feature of upstairs, and the entirety of the residence, is the corner conservatory. Ideally positioned on the south-westerly position of the home, this room is perfect for relaxation & taking in the panoramic coastal setting. 
 
Externally, Duirling Bán is positioned on a large site of approximately 0.54 acres with comfortable off-street parking for several vehicles. 
 
Along with the elevated position taking advantage of the coastal views, a testament & appeal to the property as a family home is the mature greenery & care for the gardens encompassing the grounds. 
 
Nestled off the Coast Road & just at the edge of Barna Village, Duirling Bán is within walking distance of the main thoroughfare of Barna Village & has easy access to Galway City. 
 
Duirling Bán offers an exceptional opportunity to acquire an amazing family home with rarely available uninterrupted coastal views along with mature gardens. 

Positioned in one of Galway's most popular locations viewing is highly recommended & guaranteed not to disappoint.
